scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const {spawn}=require('child_process'); const opts={stdio:'inherit',shell:true}; const procs=[spawn('npm --prefix backend run dev',opts),spawn('npm --prefix frontend run start',opts)]; let exiting=false; const shutdown=(code)=>{ if(exiting) return; exiting=true; for(const p of procs){ try{ p.kill('SIGINT'); }catch{} } process.exit(code||0); }; for(const p of procs){ p.on('exit',(code)=>shutdown(code)); p.on('error',()=>shutdown(1)); } process.on('SIGINT',()=>shutdown(0));"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
